# jenkins_folder (Data Source)

Reads information about an existing Jenkins folder. Requires the `cloudbees-folder` plugin.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the folder.

### Optional

- `folder` (String) Path of the parent folder. Leave unset to look the folder up at the Jenkins root.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the folder.
- `id` (String) Full path of the folder, for example `parent/child`.
- `url` (String) URL of the folder in Jenkins.
